title: Sprite token created by Trevor's hold trigger is displayed with Might 1 instead of 3
expected: snapshot.ts:366-368,397 resolves `might` from `cardInstance.definitionId`, which effect-context.ts:85-89 stamps as the shared `token-def-sprite` for every ability-minted Sprite. That shared id is registered first-writer-wins in the process-global registry: token.ts:70-75 (RIFTBOUND_TOKEN_DEFS.Sprite = might 1, Backline) via addToken at token.ts:131-143, and create-token.ts:119 skips re-registering if it already exists (`if (!registry.get(tokenDefinitionId))`). Meanwhile create-token.ts:199-207 registers the per-instance id with tokenDef.might=3, which is what damage/kill logic reads. So once the catalog Sprite (might 1) has been registered in the server process (sandbox addToken / earlier game), Trevor's 3-Might Temporary Sprite is displayed as might 1 in /api/game/:id/state while the engine treats it as 3 — exactly the observed divergence. Catalog value itself is also wrong: every printed Sprite token in riftbound-cards is 3 Might.
observed: State snapshot (/api/game/:id/state and pw state bfZones) reports the token as {name:'Sprite', might:1, definitionId:'token-def-sprite'}. Engine internally treats it as Might 3 (addDamage 2 -> survived with damage 2; addDamage +1 (total 3) -> killed), so the snapshot builder is resolving might from the shared per-name 'token-def-sprite' definition (catalog Sprite = 1 Might/Backline) rather than the per-instance registration that carries might 3 + Temporary.
